title: Lenny's Podcast: prioritization
summary: Start with the problem, compare impact and effort, make trade-offs visible, and test your riskiest assumption before committing.

key_ideas.title: Start with the problem
key_ideas.explanation: Ask what customer or business problem a request solves before changing the roadmap.

key_ideas.title: Compare impact and effort
key_ideas.explanation: Compare options against a shared outcome, confidence in the evidence and the effort required.

key_ideas.title: Make trade-offs visible
key_ideas.explanation: Every new commitment displaces something else; agree on the opportunity cost.

key_ideas.title: Test the riskiest assumption
key_ideas.explanation: Use a small experiment to learn before committing to a full build.

key_ideas.title: Align stakeholders
key_ideas.explanation: Acknowledge the need, explain the trade-off, and agree on what would change the decision.
